referee_caveats_inferred: The frequency ranges are swapped in the text: Band 6 is quoted as 290.51–306.01 GHz and Band 7 as 225.44–242.06 GHz, while the SPW lists and species frequencies imply the reverse
Formation-route conclusions rest on a single order-of-magnitude comparison with one published model; no model was run for MM1
Abundances depend on an H2 column density taken from another paper, with a different beam and assumptions, and on unresolved sources
Upper limits on MM3 and other COMs give no assumed Tex, FWHM or source size
Excitation temperatures of 165 and 170 K are nearly the same within errors yet used to argue a common region, while the emission is unresolved
Uncertainties for upper limits (written as value ± error) are not meaningful as stated
Statements about the NH2CHO conclusion count (four non-blended lines) and HNCO (six non-blended of seven) are consistent but the sigma limits differ (4 vs 4.5) without explanation
